description: This file is a shell script used to test the 'git submodule summary' command within the Git version control system. It defines test cases that verify the behavior of submodule summaries in various scenarios, including setup, modifications, type changes, deletions, and multiple submodules.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a submodule, commits the changes, and returns the short hash of the commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Executes a git commit with a message based on the provided arguments.
